settings.title: Authentication Status
settings.desc: Affects how you join the Minecraft server.
settings.info-premium: Auto-login with your Microsoft account. No password needed.
settings.info-cracked: You'll need to enter a password when joining the server.
settings.info-auto: The server will detect your account type automatically.
settings.link-desc: Verify your Minecraft account ownership to preserve your data when switching to premium.

microsoft.login-error: Microsoft login failed. Please try again.
microsoft.account-not-linked: No Pano account is linked to this Minecraft account. Please register first.

microsoft.no-panel-access: This account has no access to the management panel.

errors.XBOX_NO_ACCOUNT: This Microsoft account has no Xbox profile. Create one at xbox.com and try again.

errors.XBOX_CHILD: This is a child account. An adult needs to add it to a Microsoft family first.
errors.NO_MINECRAFT: This Microsoft account does not own Minecraft.
errors.STATE_INVALID: This sign-in link is no longer valid. Start again from the sign-in page.
errors.OTHER_ACCOUNT: This link was started from another account. Start again from your settings.

plugin-settings.title: Microsoft Login Settings
plugin-settings.setup-guide-title: How to set up Microsoft Login
plugin-settings.setup-step-2: Set a name for your app, select 'Personal Microsoft accounts only' as account type.
plugin-settings.setup-step-3: Under Redirect URI, select 'Web' and enter the Redirect URI shown below.
plugin-settings.setup-step-4: After registration, copy the Application (client) ID and paste it into the Client ID field.
plugin-settings.setup-step-5: Go to Certificates & Secrets → New client secret. Copy the secret value and paste it into the Client Secret field.
plugin-settings.verification-notice: Minecraft requires app verification to combat fraud and scams. Submit your app for verification at aka.ms/AppRegInfo to allow all users to use this feature.
plugin-settings.enabled-desc: Allow users to sign in and register using their Microsoft/Minecraft account.
plugin-settings.client-id-desc: Application (client) ID from Azure Portal → Overview.
plugin-settings.client-secret-desc: Secret value from Azure Portal → Certificates & Secrets.
plugin-settings.reveal-desc: Enter your password to view the client secret.
plugin-settings.redirect-uri-desc: Must match exactly with the URI registered in Azure AD.
plugin-settings.debug-logging-desc: Log detailed step-by-step information during Microsoft OAuth flows. Useful for troubleshooting.
